verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças is a government tax and customs services portal, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-integration capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
